instructions: Compare the base and current text for one changed root section. Does this change behavior? Answer yes when the change alters what the result does or covers: a capability, surface, non-goal, rule, interface, edge case, or criterion. Answer no when behavior stays the same: wording, typo, order, style, or meaning stated more precisely. A line that only records provenance, such as which issue shaped or later amended a section, is no. Renaming a term to follow a rename made elsewhere is no, unless the section's own criterion or surface now shows the new name.
